SketchUp

Beta

SketchUp 2021 or newer (GLB export on 2025+; OBJ / FBX on older needs Pro). Extension .rbz.

Download for SketchUp↗

v4.0.0-beta.1 · 16 KB · verse_publish-sketchup-4.0.0-beta.1.rbz

SHA-256e2d88cbec07bc2374630058b56ee1821e01d37cae6c22f2992a50c1847ee665e
Install
  1. Window › Extension Manager › Install Extension and pick the .rbz (do not unzip it).
  2. Extensions › Verse › Publish to Verse. Server, API key and account token are under Extensions › Verse › Settings…

Full guide: Publish from SketchUp

Revit

Beta

Revit 2021–2024 and 2025+ (Windows). Add-in zip with both builds.

Download for Revit↗

v4.0.0-beta.1 · 31 KB · VersePublish-Revit-4.0.0-beta.1.zip

SHA-2564c0a629f1102c89abd1d3854f17728ea18f9ac0160181a51519b69bde3ca4fae
Install
  1. Close Revit. Unzip; copy VersePublishRevit.dll and VersePublish.addin from build/net48 (2021–2024) or build/net8.0-windows (2025+) to %APPDATA%\Autodesk\Revit\Addins\<year>\.
  2. Start Revit, choose Always Load, open a 3D view and press Verse › Publish to Verse on the ribbon.

Full guide: Publish from Revit

Rhino

Beta

Rhino 8 (script, Windows + Mac) or Rhino 7 / 8 (plug-in, Windows). Zip.

Download for Rhino↗

v4.0.0-beta.1 · 34 KB · VersePublish-Rhino-4.0.0-beta.1.zip

SHA-256d40509f96e0750468933813a86b18488e66bc00faf4d4a5ee7038174013326bd
Install
  1. Unzip. Rhino 8: Tools › Script › Run and pick script/VersePublishRhino.py. Or drag build/net48/VersePublishRhino.rhp onto Rhino.
  2. Run VersePublish; the first run asks for the server and an optional key / token.

Full guide: Publish from Rhino

SolidWorks

Beta

SolidWorks 2019 or newer (Windows). Add-in source: build it against your SolidWorks install.

Download for SolidWorks↗

v4.0.0-beta.1 · 26 KB · VersePublish-SolidWorks-4.0.0-beta.1.zip

SHA-256d2371b43ebffe23f9a0c514ea408f837e8b01c3725a2fca42e62a7977744574b
Install
  1. Unzip; build with dotnet build -c Release -p:SolidWorksApi=<SolidWorks>\api\redist, then RegAsm /codebase VersePublishSolidWorks.dll as administrator.
  2. Tools › Add-Ins, tick Verse Publish, then Verse › Publish to Verse.

Full guide: Publish from SolidWorks

Figma (+ Spline)

Beta

Figma desktop app. Development plug-in; publishes a GLB such as a Spline export.

Download for Figma (+ Spline)↗

v4.0.0-beta.1 · 11 KB · VersePublish-Figma-4.0.0-beta.1.zip

SHA-256a9acd18f385a46ccbe4a24d1931b2067d212be293d43703c8d54ff2c198d59d2
Install
  1. Unzip. In Figma desktop: Plugins › Development › Import plugin from manifest… and pick manifest.json.
  2. Plugins › Development › Verse Publish › Insert a Verse link. Publish a GLB needs a server that accepts uploads from plug-ins (cross-origin) — not yet the case on verse.ctruh.com.

Full guide: Publish from Spline and Figma

EVERY FILE IS LISTED

Check a download.

Every file's SHA-256 is shown with it and listed in SHA256SUMS ↗.

Each package bundles verse-prepare (the optimiser) for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel), Windows and Linux. To publish to your own server instead, change the server URL in the plug-in's settings.

Run your own server ↗
shasum -a 256 <file>
# macOS / Linux

Get-FileHash <file> -Algorithm SHA256
# Windows PowerShell
